battle.name: 土耳其獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 1919年5月起，安納托利亞國民運動同希臘王國喺安納托利亞西部對抗三年零五個月。希軍靠騎兵同裝甲推進，國民軍就以縱深塹壕、砲兵集中火力同騎兵迂迴應戰，喺薩卡里亞同大攻勢扭轉戰局，逼退希軍。線膛砲確立嘅射程優先觀念，就以克里普後膛砲嘅形態支撐住全線火力。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 土耳其獨立戰爭係安納托利亞國民運動同希臘王國軍隊喺1919年5月至1922年10月之間嘅一場戰爭，戰場橫跨安納托利亞高原、托羅斯山脈同愛琴海岸。安納托利亞方面，Mustafa Kemal於1920年4月23日喺安卡拉召開大國民議會並成立臨時政府，軍事上將三支並存嘅部隊統一編制：正規軍、保護法軍同國民防禦軍，合稱國民軍，由總參謀部擬定作戰方案，議會政府掌握外交同軍政預算。地方義勇軍喺編制化之前承擔咗1919至1920年嘅大部分游擊同破壞任務，其骨幹之後被整編入各師。希臘方面由遠征軍總部同安納托利亞軍團構成，陸軍下轄第2、第3、第4、第5師同獨立騎兵旅，另有安納托利亞常備兵同山地營，總指揮權先後喺Stylianos Gonatas同Georgios Kondylis之間調整，戰術主導權則喺Konstantinos Tserpilis所擬嘅安納托利亞作戰方案中。此外法國佔領奇里西亞，義大利控制西南安納托利亞同多德羅斯，聯軍仍控制君士坦丁堡同海峽，亞美尼亞志願軍喺東路協助希軍。《塞維條約》嘅簽署國名單上冇安納托利亞國民運動，但佢嘅軍隊係1920年後安納托利亞唯一成建制嘅抵抗力量。
countriesEn: The Turkish War of Independence was fought between the Anatolian National Movement and the armed forces of the Kingdom of Greece from May 1919 to October 1922, across the Anatolian plateau, the Taurus mountains and the Aegean littoral. On the Anatolian side, Mustafa Kemal convened the Grand National Assembly at Ankara on 23 April 1920 and established a provisional government; militarily he fused three forces that had existed side by side, namely the regular army, the Law of Protection Army and the National Defence Army, collectively the National Army, with the General Staff drawing up the operational plan while the assembly government controlled foreign affairs and the defence budget. Before they were regularised, the local volunteer forces (Kuva-yi Milliye) carried most of the raiding and sabotage of 1919 and 1920, and their backbone was later absorbed into the divisions. On the Greek side the command structure ran from the Expeditionary Headquarters down to the Army of Asia Minor, whose army corps included the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th Divisions together with independent cavalry brigades, alongside the Asia Minor conscript battalions and mountain troops; overall command passed in turn between Stylianos Gonatas and Georgios Kondylis, while the operational concept came from the Asia Minor campaign plan drawn up by Konstantinos Tserpilis. France held Cilicia, Italy controlled south-western Anatolia and the Dodecanese, the Allied powers still held Constantinople and the straits, and Armenian volunteer forces assisted the Greeks on the eastern front. The National Movement was not on the list of signatories to the Treaty of Sèvres, yet its army was the only organised resisting force in Anatolia after 1920.
people: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk係整場戰爭嘅核心人物。佢1919年5月19日以陸軍上校身分喺薩姆松登陸，同月發出阿馬西亞通告；1920年3月被大國民議會推舉為全權代表；4月23日當選議長；6月18日兼任國民軍總司令，此後喺薩卡里亞戰役同1922年大攻勢中親自定下作戰方針。總參謀長Fevzi Çakmak擬定薩卡里亞嘅防禦部署同大攻勢嘅包圍方案，係「以縱深工事換取反擊時機」呢個構思嘅主要設計者；參謀長İsmet İnönü主持薩卡里亞正面作戰，並喺大攻勢之後率軍追到布魯明；Ali Fuat Cebesoy負責安卡拉同西部戰線嘅防衛；Şükrü Naili Gökberk指揮騎兵集團軍，喺大菲茲戰役中擊潰希軍騎兵；Kemalettin Gökçen主持後方軍務同新兵組訓。希臘方面，總理Eleftherios Venizelos喺歐洲主導對土政策；Nikolaos Plastiras以第3師指揮官身分參與薩卡里亞，1922年9月回國後推翻君士坦丁堡政府；Stylianos Gonatas任安納托利亞軍總司令，Georgios Kondylis先後指揮安納托利亞集團軍群，Alexandros Papanastasiou推動軍制同行政改革，Konstantinos Tserpilis任安納托利亞軍團參謀長。錫瓦斯大會通過「主權無條件屬於全體民族」同安卡拉嘅民族抗戰法令，都係喺關鍵節點由議會集體決定，唔係單一將領嘅軍事衝動。
peopleEn: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk was the central figure of the entire war. He landed at Samsun in May 1919 as a lieutenant colonel, and issued the Amasya Circular in the same month; in March 1920 the Grand National Assembly appointed him its plenipotentiary representative; on 23 April he was elected speaker; on 18 June he took over as commander-in-chief of the National Army, and from then on he personally set the operational direction for the Battle of Sakarya and for the great offensive of 1922. Chief of the General Staff Fevzi Çakmak drew up the defensive deployment at Sakarya and the envelopment plan for the great offensive, and was the principal author of the idea of trading depth and prepared works for the moment to counterattack. Chief of staff İsmet İnönü commanded the front at Sakarya and led the pursuit to Blouming after the great offensive. Ali Fuat Cebesoy handled the defence of Ankara and of the western front; Şükrü Naili Gökberk commanded the cavalry group that broke the Greek cavalry at Dumlupınar; Kemalettin Gökçen directed rear-area affairs and the training of recruits. On the Greek side, Prime Minister Eleftherios Venizelos directed policy towards Turkey from Europe; Nikolaos Plastiras fought at Sakarya as commander of the 3rd Division and, returning to Greece in September 1922, overturned the Constantinople government; Stylianos Gonatas commanded the Army of Asia Minor, Georgios Kondylis led the Army Group of Asia Minor in turn, Alexandros Papanastasiou drove military and administrative reform, and Konstantinos Tserpilis was chief of staff of the Army of Asia Minor. The Sivas Congress resolution that sovereignty belongs unconditionally to the whole nation, and the Ankara declaration of national resistance, were collective decisions of the assembly at decisive moments rather than the military impulse of a single general.
kits: 任務單呢件線膛砲係1850年前後嘅德式口裝線膛野戰砲，銅製炮身、鐵箍加固、硬木炮架，代表嘅係「射程蓋過步槍」呢個砲兵新準則嘅確立，亦係後膛砲出現之前野戰砲兵標準化嘅樣板。1919年時呢類口裝線膛砲已經退出野戰序列：奧斯曼陸軍嘅野戰砲位幾乎全部換成克里普後膛式，常見者為7.5釐米野戰砲、10.5釐米榴彈砲同舊式105毫米重型榴彈砲，口裝老砲則被降為要塞固定砲位、海岸防衛同教學用途，一部分殘件散落喺安納托利亞各座要塞，亦有部分經戰後清算落入希軍同聯軍手中。國民運動方面靠清點舊奧斯曼庫存同徵用殘件重建砲兵：以安卡拉軍械總局、埃斯基謝希爾兵工廠同開塞利工場為維修中心，將7.5釐米野戰砲同10.5釐米榴彈砲編入師砲兵營，舊式重榴彈砲則用嚟對付希軍縱深炮兵陣地。輕武器同樣係拼湊：毛瑟1893式、1888式毛瑟、馬丁尼、溫徹斯特等步槍，Maxim水冷式重機槍，遊擊隊大量自製地雷同手投炸彈。運輸以馱獸、火車同極少量汽車為主，每門野戰砲需六至八匹馬拖曳。
kitsEn: The kit listed for this card is a German muzzle-loading rifled field gun of about 1850, with a bronze barrel, iron reinforcing hoops and a wooden carriage; it stands for the establishment of the new artillery doctrine that range beats the rifle, and it is the standard pattern of field artillery before breech-loaders appeared. By 1919 this class of muzzle-loading rifled gun had already left the line of battle: the Ottoman field artillery had been almost entirely replaced by Krupp breech-loaders, with 7.5 cm field guns, 10.5 cm howitzers and old 105 mm heavy howitzers as the common types, while the obsolete muzzle-loading pieces were demoted to fixed batteries in fortresses, to coastal defence and to training duties. Some of the survivors lay scattered in the Anatolian fortresses, and some passed into Greek and Allied hands in the postwar settlement. The National Movement rebuilt its artillery by taking inventory of old Ottoman stocks and reclaiming surviving pieces: the arsenal at Ankara, the Eskisehir workshops and the Kayseri factory became the repair centres, and 7.5 cm field guns and 10.5 cm howitzers were formed into divisional artillery, while the old heavy howitzers were used against the Greek artillery in depth. The small arms were equally mixed: Mauser 1893, Model 1888 Mauser, Martini and Winchester rifles, Maxim water-cooled heavy machine guns, and large numbers of home-made mines and hand grenades turned out by the raiding parties. Movement depended on pack animals, the railway and a very small number of motor vehicles, each field gun needing six to eight horses for towing.
tactics: 安納托利亞方面嘅戰術主軸有兩層。守勢一端，總參謀部喺薩卡里亞河大彎揀咗一條約100公里長嘅正面，構築上千座塹壕、機槍巢同砲位群，唔急於反擊，只係等希軍投入攻勢。1921年8月23日希軍第2、第3師發動攻擊，側翼越過河彎深入，進至距安卡拉約20公里，砲兵失去掩護，國民軍於9月13日轉入反擊，攻勢逐日受挫，最終以希軍退回原出發線收場。攻勢一端，1922年8月26日大攻勢以22個師分三路推進：中央正面強取阿菲永卡拉希薩爾，右路沿艾菲索斯河谷北上，左路由蘇雷亞·康凱率領經屈奇門德列斯河谷推進，部隊以旅為單位晝夜連續行軍，越過安納托利亞高原嘅山脊。9月30日大菲茲戰役中，兩翼騎兵迂迴插入希軍側背，摧毀其炮兵營同彈藥庫，俘獲大量希軍官兵。與此同時，遊擊隊長期破壞安納托利亞鐵路嘅橋樑同車站，令希軍補給線無法穩定運轉，逼迫希軍作戰縱深同糧秣儲備下降，後方補給全靠馬車同馱獸。希軍方面沿用希臘本土嘅密集縱隊同驛站供給制，攻勢前集中全軍補給，但一旦正面被頂住，側翼缺乏掩護。國民軍由守轉攻只花咗約一個月，反映佢哋已經將以國家動員支撐嘅機動作戰制度化。
tacticsEn: There were two layers to the Anatolian tactical concept. On the defensive side the General Staff chose a front about 100 km long at the great bend of the Sakarya river and built over a thousand trenches, machine-gun nests and gun positions, refusing to counterattack and simply waiting for the Greeks to commit their assault. On 23 August 1921 the Greek 2nd and 3rd Divisions attacked; their flanks pushed across the bend and advanced to within about 20 km of Ankara, leaving their artillery without cover, and the National Army counterattacked on 13 September, the Greek attack being worn down day by day until they fell back on their own starting line. On the offensive side, the great offensive of 26 August 1922 advanced with 22 divisions in three groups: the centre struck hard for Afyonkarahisar, the right group moved north along the Aegean valley, and the left under Süreyya Conker pushed through the Küçük Menderes valley, the formations marching day and night by brigade over the ridges of the Anatolian plateau. At the Battle of Dumlupınar on 30 August the cavalry on both wings wheeled round into the Greek rear, wrecking its artillery parks and ammunition dumps and taking large numbers of Greek prisoners. At the same time the raiding parties systematically destroyed bridges and stations on the Anatolian railway, so that the Greek supply line could not run steadily, forcing the shrinking of the Greek operational depth and of its food and fodder stocks, with the rear areas supplied only by wagon and pack animal. The Greeks kept the dense columns and the depot relay system of the home army, massing supplies before an offensive, but once the front was held they had no cover on the flanks. It took the National Army barely a month to turn from defence to attack, showing that movement warfare sustained by national mobilisation had already become institutionalised.
data: 人口同兵源係呢場戰爭最吃緊嘅限制。1920年人口普查顯示安納托利亞約有750萬人，國家總兵力難以超過人口嘅一小部分；到1921年薩卡里亞會戰時，國民軍作戰部隊常被引述為約十萬人，含地方守備同後方預備役則更多；大攻勢時國民軍作戰兵力約二十萬，全戰期累計動員人數常被引述為接近五十萬。希臘方面，1921年高峰時喺安納托利亞嘅軍隊約二十二萬人（各方統計自二十萬至二十五萬不等），配有40至50輛坦克，以法制Schneider同Renault FT為主，相當一部分缺乏備件，另有數千名騎兵，以第3同第5騎兵師為骨幹，佔領線由馬爾馬拉海沿岸拉到托羅斯山，總長逾500公里。薩卡里亞一役戰線長約100公里，兩個師投入攻擊，自8月23日至9月13日打了22天，希軍推進至距安卡拉約20公里；常被引述嘅數字係希軍傷亡約2.5萬人、其中陣亡約四千至五千人，國民軍陣亡同負傷亦約兩萬至三萬人，但雙方數字都係各方自報、互有出入。1922年8月30日至9月1日大菲茲戰役，國民軍投入兵力常被引述為約十萬人，希軍前線同縱深合計約十三萬人；役後希軍被俘一萬餘人，數百門火炮、數百挺重機槍同數千匹馬匹被繳獲。時間上，戰爭自1919年5月至1922年10月11日《穆達尼亞停戰協議》凡三年五個月，最終條約《洛桑條約》在1923年7月24日簽訂。
dataEn: Population and manpower were the tightest constraint of the whole war. The 1920 census put the population of Anatolia at about 7.5 million, and the state's total armed strength could never exceed a small fraction of that; by the Battle of Sakarya in 1921 the National Army field forces are commonly quoted at about 100,000 men, with local garrisons and the rear-area reserves adding considerably more, and by the great offensive the National Army numbered roughly 200,000 in the field, the total number mobilised over the war being commonly quoted at close to half a million. On the Greek side the force in Asia Minor peaked in 1921 at about 220,000 men, with estimates ranging from 200,000 to 250,000, equipped with 40 to 50 tanks, principally French Schneider and Renault FT types of which a good part lacked spares, plus several thousand cavalry organised around the 3rd and 5th Cavalry Divisions; the occupation line ran from the Sea of Marmara to the Taurus, over 500 km in all. At Sakarya the front was about 100 km long, two divisions committed to the assault, and the battle ran 22 days from 23 August to 13 September, with the Greeks driven back to within some 20 km of Ankara. The figures most often quoted are Greek casualties of about 25,000, of whom perhaps 4,000 to 5,000 were killed, while National Army dead and wounded are likewise put at some 20,000 to 30,000, though both sides' numbers are self-reported and differ widely. At the Battle of Dumlupınar from 30 August to 1 September 1922 the National Army is commonly quoted as having committed about 100,000 men against roughly 130,000 Greeks in the line and in depth; after the battle over 12,000 Greeks were taken prisoner and several hundred guns, several hundred heavy machine guns and several thousand horses were captured. In time, the war ran from May 1919 to the Mudanya Armistice of 11 October 1922, three years and five months in all, and the final treaty, the Treaty of Lausanne, was signed on 24 July 1923.
cause: 打起來嘅直接原因係戰後安排。一戰敗後簽訂嘅《塞維條約》將鄂圖曼置於瓜分邊上，鄂圖曼本土被劃分為若干由希臘、意大利、法國、英國同美國管轄或佔領嘅區域；希臘軍隊1919年3月15日進入伊茲密爾，聯軍同年3月16日接管君士坦丁堡，民族主義者視之為國家解體嘅開端。1920年6月希軍越過安納托利亞前線，7月佔領埃斯基謝希爾同開塞利，前線距安卡拉不足100公里，安卡拉直接受威脅。國民運動嘅回應分成政治同軍事兩條線：政治上，1919年11月錫瓦斯大會通過「主權無條件屬於全體民族」，1920年4月成立大國民議會，5月成立安卡拉臨時政府；軍事上，Mustafa Kemal嘅阿馬西亞通告啟動各地民團，之後逐步由零散遊擊轉為編制作戰。1921年3月希軍第二次進攻埃斯基謝希爾失敗，4月21日安卡拉議會通過「民族抗戰」法令，正式宣告進入全國性抵抗狀態，同時切斷同佔領當局談判退路。列強內部對土政策分歧亦相當關鍵：英法意三方支持安納托利亞民族政府作為對付希臘同蘇俄嘅緩衝，雖然最終並未換來實質讓步。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting lay in the postwar settlement. The Treaty of Sèvres, concluded after the defeat in the Great War, placed the Ottoman Empire on the edge of partition, its homeland being carved into zones assigned to or occupied by Greece, Italy, France, Britain and the United States; Greek troops entered Izmir on 15 March 1919, the Allies took over Constantinople on 16 March of the same year, and the nationalists read all of this as the opening of national dissolution. In June 1920 the Greek army crossed the Anatolian line of contact, and in July it occupied Eskisehir and Kayseri, bringing the front to within 100 km of Ankara and putting the capital itself under threat. The National Movement answered on two levels, political and military. Politically the Sivas Congress of November 1919 affirmed that sovereignty belongs unconditionally to the whole nation, the Grand National Assembly met in April 1920 and a provisional government was formed at Ankara in May. Militarily Mustafa Kemal's Amasya Circular set the local militia in motion, and fighting gradually moved from scattered raiding to set-piece operations. After the Greek failure before Eskisehir in March 1921, the assembly at Ankara passed the declaration of national resistance on 21 April, formally entering a state of nationwide resistance and simultaneously closing off the path of negotiation with the occupying authorities. Divisions among the powers mattered as well: Britain, France and Italy were willing to back the Anatolian national government as a buffer against Greece and Soviet Russia, though that backing never translated into real concessions.
impact: 最大嘅影響係鄂圖曼帝國嘅終結同新國家嘅出現。1923年7月24日《洛桑條約》取代《塞維條約》，確認安納托利亞同君士坦丁堡歸土耳其，劃定東色雷斯界線，規定海峽非軍事化，廢除治外權同舊式條約，並以僑民交換安排處理安納托利亞同希臘兩岸嘅人口流動。1923年10月29日大國民議會宣佈成立土耳其共和國，首都安卡拉。軍事上，國民軍由游擊隊長成常備軍，軍隊編制、兵站同後勤制度成為新政權嘅骨架；安納托利亞戰役亦被寫入二十世紀軍事學，成為「以國家動員同退卻時主動殲滅敵人縱深」嘅典型案例。希臘方面則係相反方向嘅衝擊：安納托利亞戰線崩潰直接導致1922年9月君士坦丁堡局面嘅崩解，內戰隨後爆發，1923年希臘建立共和國，1924年再因戰費同安置軍人問題爆發第二次政變。長期睇，民族運動軍人喺建國後持續扮演政治角色，令軍隊成為國家社會最有力嘅組織力量之一。
impactEn: The greatest consequence was the end of the Ottoman Empire and the emergence of a new state. The Treaty of Lausanne of 24 July 1923 replaced the Treaty of Sèvres, confirming Turkish sovereignty over Anatolia and Constantinople, drawing the frontier in Eastern Thrace, providing for the demilitarisation of the straits, abolishing the capitulations and the old treaties, and settling the movement of populations between Anatolia and Greece through an exchange arrangement. On 29 October 1923 the Grand National Assembly proclaimed the Republic of Turkey, with Ankara as its capital. Militarily the National Army grew out of the raiding bands into a standing army, and its organisation, its supply service and its logistics became the skeleton of the new regime; the Anatolian campaign was also written into twentieth-century military literature as the textbook case of national mobilisation and of actively destroying the enemy in depth while withdrawing. For Greece the shock ran in the opposite direction: the collapse of the Asia Minor front directly triggered the breakdown of the Constantinople situation in September 1922, civil war followed, the republic was established in 1923, and a second coup came in 1924 over war debts and the settlement of the soldiers. In the long run the men of the National Movement kept playing a political role after independence, and the army became one of the most powerful organising forces in the society of the new state.

resultEn: The Anatolian National Movement won outright. After the great offensive opened on 26 August 1922 the Greek Army of Asia Minor came apart; National Army cavalry entered Izmir on 9 September and the main body occupied the city on the 12th. The Greeks abandoned central and southern Anatolia, and the remnants withdrew towards the Sea of Marmara through the neighbourhood of Smyrna and Troy, abandoning large quantities of guns, horses and transport on the way. The last Greek troops were evacuated by sea before the end of October 1922, and during the withdrawal the quarters of the city of Smyrna were set alight, the cause and the responsibility for which remain disputed in the sources. The Mudanya Armistice of 11 October 1922 recognised Anatolia as belonging to the national government and provided for the disarmament of the Greek forces; the soldiers and politicians who came home by ship immediately involved themselves in a coup and the old government fell. The Treaty of Lausanne was signed on 24 July 1923, writing the legal outcome of the war into international law and giving Turkey the status of a national state; the republic was proclaimed on 29 October of the same year, and the war closed with a double confirmation of national form and of the frontier. For the National Army, the three years and five months from May 1919 to October 1922 completed the transformation of local militia into a standing army of 200,000 men.
